exposure: pH of ≤7.1 and base excess of ≤-10 mmol/L
pH of ≤7.0 and base excess of ≤-12 mmol/L
outcome: Incidence of umbilical artery pH ≤7.0 or ≤7.1 and base excess ≤-12 mmol/L or ≤-10 mmol/L
cohort: Term, singleton, nonanomalous neonates with 5-minute Apgar scores of ≥7
finding: Neonates with reassuring 5-minute Apgar scores can still have neonatal acidemia, which is associated with higher rates of adverse outcomes, including respiratory distress syndrome, neonatal intensive care unit admission, and neonatal sepsis.
mod_finding: Cesarean deliveries were associated with higher rates of neonatal acidemia despite normal 5-minute Apgar scores (5.8% vs 2.8%; P<.001).
